name: Espressif ESP32-P4 SoC Product Page
notes: Official Espressif Systems product page for the ESP32-P4 high-performance SoC. Details dual-core RISC-V CPU up to 400 MHz with AI instruction extensions, 768 KB on-chip SRAM, 8 KB TCM, MIPI-CSI/DSI, and hardware pixel processing accelerator (PPA). Verifies that Espressif does NOT publish an NPU TOPS figure for ESP32-P4 because AI acceleration is achieved via CPU ISA vector/AI extensions rather than a dedicated discrete NPU block.
